report.summary: Reviewed shadow_shell.py chunk 1 of 1; all docstring claims kept, no defects found, one uncheckable claim about adapter behavior.

handoff.purpose: Manages running an agent task inside a git worktree and returns a CandidateBranch result.

symbols.name: CandidateBranch
symbols.note: Dataclass representing a completed task on a dedicated git branch, with fields branch_name, worktree_path, task, completed, error, score.

symbols.name: ShadowShellManager
symbols.note: Manager that spawns an adapter and runs the agent inside a given GitWorktree. Constructor stores worktree_manager, adapter, base_commit, config.

symbols.name: run_task
symbols.note: Async method that creates a new worktree, runs the agent task, commits changes if successful, and returns a CandidateBranch. Cleans up worktree on failure.

claims.text: Represents a completed task on a dedicated git branch.
claims.why: The dataclass fields (branch_name, worktree_path, task, completed) accurately represent a completed task on a dedicated branch.

claims.text: Spawns an adapter and runs the agent inside a given GitWorktree.
claims.why: The class constructor takes an adapter and worktree_manager, and run_task creates a worktree and runs the agent via the adapter.

claims.text: Executes the agent task inside a new worktree and returns a CandidateBranch.
claims.why: run_task creates a new worktree via worktree_manager.create_worktree, runs the task, and returns a CandidateBranch.

claims.text: The task is the initial one-shot prompt.
claims.why: session_config['prompt'] is set to the task string, and the session is created with that config.

claims.text: cwd is the worktree, and the adapter is required to honor it at process launch.
claims.why: The code sets session_config['cwd'] to the worktree path, but whether the adapter honors it is not observable in this chunk.

claims.text: Commit any changes the agent made in the worktree
claims.why: The code calls worktree_manager.commit_candidate with the worktree path and a commit message.

observations.what: The run_task method catches all exceptions and stores the error in the candidate, but does not re-raise; callers must check candidate.completed.
The worktree cleanup only happens if the candidate is not completed, which is consistent with the success path.
The comment about the adapter honoring cwd is a requirement, but the code does not enforce it; if the adapter does not honor it, the agent may run in the wrong directory.
